high_level_description: The image depicts a three-dimensional representation of the coat of arms of the Republic of the Philippines. The design is set against a plain white background, which makes the colors and details of the emblem stand out prominently. Shape and Structure: The emblem is oval-shaped with a blue border. Inside the blue border, there is a shield divided into two sections: the upper section is white, and the lower section is red. Design Elements: White Section (Top): There are five stars arranged in a circular pattern around the top edge of the shield
